exceptions.title: Non-working day calendar
exceptions.empty: No exceptions yet (weekends and Japanese public holidays are used)

hint.invalidType: Invalid type (this row is not applied to the schedule; select the type again)
hint.duplicate: There are multiple rows for the same date (working day takes precedence)
hint.alreadyWeekend: This date is already a weekend (no need to specify)
hint.alreadyHoliday: This date is already a public holiday (no need to specify)
hint.alreadyWorkday: This date is already a working day (no need to specify)

exceptions.note: Priority: working day > holiday > Japanese public holiday > weekend. A "working day" makes the date a working day even on weekends and public holidays, and a "holiday" makes a weekday a non-working day. Changes here apply to CPM, resource leveling and the planned finish date.

upcoming.title: Upcoming public holidays (calculated automatically, read-only)
upcoming.note: Japanese public holidays (including substitute and citizens' holidays) are treated as non-working days automatically. Add only other holidays (such as company holidays) and working days on weekends or public holidays in the table above.
